title: AI Trade Faces Earnings Test: Market Snapshot
summary: Big tech earnings this week drew mixed reactions. Investor jitters are shifting from cash flows and profits to how the AI build-out is being financed.

title: Sir Martin Sorrell on AI's Impact on Advertising
summary: S4Capital's Martin Sorrell says AI is sharply cutting the time and cost of creating advertising content, forcing agencies to rethink pricing models, and highlights AI personalization at scale.

title: Nvidia, TCV Invest in AI Video Startup Higgsfield in Series B Extension
summary: AI video startup Higgsfield attracted investment from Nvidia and TCV in a Series B extension to fund global infrastructure and hiring.

title: Asia Investors Seek Havens as AI Selloff Deepens
summary: A selloff in tech giants and escalating Middle East hostilities pushed investors into bonds, while a Chinese tech repricing deepens across Asia.

title: Europe’s largest landlord exposed to €8bn hit from Berlin apartment plans
summary: Vonovia, the largest landlord in Europe, is exposed to compulsory purchase of 120,000 Berlin flats under proposals from state election winners, a potential hit of about €8bn, the FT reports.

title: AI oversight needs a different model to banking
summary: The FT argues that AI oversight needs a different model from banking, since financial regulatory structures were cobbled together over a century and this technology needs its own scrutiny.

title: Calpers retreats from Big Tech as AI rally falters
summary: California's retirement fund Calpers cut its Magnificent 7 holdings as doubts grow about lofty valuations and soaring AI spending, according to the FT.

title: DeepSeek, MiniMax Win Approval for Global Use, State Media Says
summary: DeepSeek and MiniMax won approval to deploy their models overseas, part of a wave of Chinese AI technologies Beijing will allow to operate globally, per state media.

title: AI Tech Fears Push Global Credit Spreads to 17-Month High
summary: Global credit-spread metrics signal the biggest risk-off sentiment in more than a year, as an AI stock selloff and geopolitical tensions send investors to safe havens. Spreads are at a 17-month high.

title: FailSafe President on AI hacking, Cybersecurity
summary: The president of cybersecurity firm FailSafe discusses what institutions should do to protect websites and services from vulnerabilities and AI-driven cyberattacks amid a surge in security loopholes.

title: SK Data Center Arm Plans to Fund $350B AI Buildout
summary: The CEO of SK Group's data center arm says it is in talks with big tech firms and financial investors to fund a planned $350 billion AI infrastructure buildout.

title: Nu México advierte que el reto de los pagos digitales será la confianza de los mexicanos
summary: Nu México advierte que el principal reto de los pagos digitales en el país será la confianza de los mexicanos, según Expansión.

title: CNA revisa 30% más fusiones; baja 10% tiempos de resolución
summary: La Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio revisa 30% más operaciones de concentración desde que entraron en vigor los nuevos umbrales que obligan a notificar fusiones y adquisiciones, con 10% menos tiempo de resolución.

title: Van por gerentes y supervisores
summary: Una columna de El Economista advierte que una herramienta de IA pone en riesgo de desaparición a supervisores y gerentes que trabajan desde el escritorio, mientras quienes están en planta parecen a salvo.

title: OpenAI Shifts Value to $1.25 Trillion as Funding Talks Finalize
summary: OpenAI is now targeting a $1.25 trillion valuation in the final stages of a funding round of about $30 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. The figure is below the $1.4tn price tag it floated earlier this month, per the FT.

title: La Ley de Economía Digital habilita la CURP y el Expediente Ciudadano para apertura remota de cuentas
summary: Según Expansión, la Ley de Economía Digital habilita el uso de la CURP y el Expediente Ciudadano para la apertura remota de cuentas.

title: Regulador en México pone en la mira aceptación de vales de despensa en comercios
summary: La autoridad antimonopolio de México investiga posibles prácticas indebidas en la aceptación de vales de despensa y medios de pago electrónico en comercios minoristas como supermercados y tiendas de conveniencia.

title: SK Hynix Pulls Solidigm’s $10 Billion IPO on Regulatory Pushback
summary: SK Hynix scrapped a potential $10 billion US IPO of its Solidigm unit after strong opposition from regulators and shareholders. It is the latest firm to pull an IPO amid growing investor unease over the AI boom.

title: El peso mexicano se encamina a una depreciación semanal de 1.2% frente al dólar
summary: El peso mexicano se encamina a una depreciación semanal de 1.2% frente al dólar, según Expansión.

title: OpenAI trims valuation target to $1.25tn after pitching higher price
summary: The FT reports OpenAI trimmed its valuation target to $1.25tn after pitching a higher price. The AI lab had floated $1.4tn earlier this month, according to documents seen by the FT.

title: Regreso de comisiones bancarias y compra de más infraestructura para pagos digitales presionará el margen de gasolineras
summary: Expansión reporta que el regreso de las comisiones bancarias y la compra de más infraestructura para pagos digitales presionarán el margen de ganancia de las gasolineras.

title: ¿Vale la pena comprar bonos latinoamericanos? Morgan Stanley señala cuatro mercados con primas atractivas
summary: Morgan Stanley ve oportunidades en bonos soberanos de Colombia, Argentina, México y Ecuador, donde los riesgos específicos de cada país mantienen los diferenciales por encima de los de emisores estadounidenses comparables.

title: If AI displaces human workers, they will lose more than just pay
summary: The Economist argues that if AI displaces human workers, they stand to lose more than income, since work has value beyond the pay it provides.

title: Precios de la vivienda social se disparan en Colombia mientras aceleran los costos de construirlas
summary: Los precios de la vivienda de interés social en Colombia subieron 10,5% anual en el segundo trimestre de 2026, mientras aceleran los costos de construcción.

title: AI compute is the new oil—and needs a new market
summary: Financial firms are racing to create instruments to trade processing power, The Economist reports, under the thesis that AI compute is the new oil and needs a new market.
